_comment: Nudge copy for the unattended runner. Plain English, short, contractions, no jargon. The problem sentence and the closing ask are both chosen from what is actually wrong: someone short on hours needs two minutes, someone whose hours are complete but logged late needs a different habit, and telling the second person to spend two minutes is nonsense they will notice.
_fields: Templates take {name} {problem} {cta} {streak_phrase} {link}. Everything else is assembled in send_nudges.py so the grammar agrees with the data: hours drop trailing zeros, days appear as weekday names, and singular or plural is chosen per person.
_clauses: Sentence fragments, no trailing full stop. Write the first word in whatever case reads naturally: send_nudges.py capitalises the clause when the template starts a sentence with it, and lowercases it when it follows a comma, so the same clause works in both templates. Do not start a clause with a name or anything else that must stay capitalised.
clause_hours_only: you're at {logged} of {expected} hours for this week
clause_days_only: your hours add up, but {missing} {was_were} logged late rather than on the day
clause_both: you're at {logged} of {expected} hours, with nothing logged for {missing}
clause_fallback: your hours are behind for this week
_ctas: The closing ask, matched to the problem. A backfiller has nothing to catch up on, so asking them to spend two minutes reads as a message nobody bothered to check.
cta_hours_firm: Please get these in before Friday cutoff, or we can't bill the client for them:
cta_days_light: Worth logging at the end of each day, that is the only way it stays accurate:
cta_days_firm: Please log on the day from now on, hours pieced together later aren't something we can put in front of a client:
_streaks: Firm template only. A streak crosses weeks, so a raw day number reads like nonsense in a weekly nudge.
streak_long: you've been behind every day for over a week now
weekly_digest_header: *Timesheet week of {week_of}*  ({scored} of {total} scored, team mean {mean})
weekly_digest_footer: Full JSON is attached to the workflow run. Paste it into a session for the read on patterns and the coaching notes.
failure_alert: :warning: Timesheet automation failed on {workflow}. Nobody was nudged on this run. Logs: {run_url}
